item.title: Corrections redirect replies in progress
item.summary: When you send a follow-up while Murph is still writing a reply, Murph can switch to your correction right away instead of finishing the outdated answer first.
item.details: This applies to quick follow-ups in the same conversation before Murph's reply is complete. Anything Murph has already started, like saving a reminder, finishes once and is not repeated. Occasionally the earlier answer may still arrive just before the corrected one.
